text:
```sql
SELECT 
    id,
    reparto,
    data,
    importo,
    SUM(importo) OVER (
        PARTITION BY reparto 
        ORDER BY data NULLS LAST
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS somma_cumulata
FROM progetti
ORDER BY reparto, data NULLS LAST;
```<|im_end|>
